Delete account

搭慕 · 담우 · Damu

Pre-launch draft: based on current code and operator information. Retention enforcement, overseas processing disclosures and final erasure remain pending. Effective date to be confirmed.

Request in the App

My → Settings → Account management → Delete account. Enter your registered email and current password and confirm. The account and push notifications are disabled, and you are signed out.

If you cannot sign in

Email damumuapp@gmail.com from your registered mailbox with subject “Damu account deletion request”. Provide the registered address and request, never passwords, codes or ID documents. After verifying control, the operator targets processing in 1–2 business days. Future phone/Google sign-in needs its corresponding verification flow.

Removal and retention

Proposed removal covers credentials, profile, avatar, push devices, preferences and public posts. Shared messages/images are proposed to remain for one year from sending with profile linkage removed; necessary report/penalty evidence for one year from case closure. Activity cancellation and consequences for other members remain to be confirmed.

Implementation status

The App/API support a password-verified request and account suspension. Final erasure, shared-record treatment and scheduled cleanup are not yet complete. Complete these before enabling the policy and service for production. Uninstallation is not deletion.
